text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian Authority auditor finds 40 percent of budget wasted or misused.
- Israel government says no halt to building Jewish settlement in Jerusalem.
- Cities to support local authorities strike.
- Partial sabbath closure of street in Jerusalem passes quietly.
- Prime Minister Netanyahu rejects proposal to suspend building Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem.
- Attorney General Rubinstein says prime minister and justice minister's faith in him not damaged by his report on government scandal.
- Jewish groups protest at Pope's beatification of nun Edith Stein, former Jew, who killed in Auschwitz.
- Credit card company says another company is trying to coordinate with it against interests of customers.
- In Israel, hopes for a process of moderation in Iran after election.
- Right-wing to Netanyahu: stopping building of East Jerusalem settlement will break up the government.
- Sunday Times: Secret report to Netanyahu from Shin Bet secret service: Settlement policy will lead to war.
